steps.en: Refund letters are sent to the print vendor
steps.id: Letter refund dikirim ke vendor cetak
steps.why_en: The print vendor only gets notice letters, not refund letters.
steps.why_id: Vendor cetak hanya menerima letter notice, belum letter refund.

steps.en: Offender opens a personal link and submits bank details
steps.id: Offender membuka link unik dan mengisi bank details
steps.why_en: The page and unique link for bank details do not exist.
steps.why_id: Halaman dan link unik untuk bank details tidak ada.

steps.en: System receives and checks the submitted bank details
steps.id: Sistem menerima dan memeriksa bank details yang dikirim
steps.why_en: Receiving bank details has not been built.

steps.en: Refund advice is updated with the bank details
steps.id: Refund advice diperbarui dengan bank details
steps.why_en: No refund advice or bank column exists.
steps.why_id: Refund advice dan kolom bank tidak ada.

steps.en: Refund advice is sent to Cumulus to be paid
steps.id: Refund advice dikirim ke Cumulus untuk dibayar
steps.why_en: The Cumulus interface does not exist.
